sentimento.text1: The presidential book has accumulated USD 141.39M and the price on this page is from the confirmed reading of Sep 1, 8:34 PM BRT (11:34 PM UTC). ONE NATIONAL POLL WAS RELEASED THIS TUESDAY, Real Time Big Data (BR-03490/2026, field Aug 27 to 31, n=2,000), and it is the first in the panel whose field reaches Aug 31, that is, the first to cover the full week after the campaign broadcast slot began on Aug 28.
sentimento.text2: In the price, the leader did not move and holds at 55.50% for the fourth day running. The runner-up gave up 0.10pp, to 38.95%, and the distance between the two widened to 16.55pp, against 16.45pp yesterday. What moved were the third and fourth names, and the contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving.
sentimento.text3: The pollster published TWO first-round scenarios and they give different numbers for the second and third places. With Pablo Marçal on the list, the runner-up has 29% and Augusto Cury 10%. Without Marçal, the runner-up has 30% and Cury 11%. The day’s headlines circulated the second scenario without saying which one it was, and that is why the panel carries both, labelled.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 38.95% (vol USD 9.43M) in the presidential contract, down 0.10pp, and 86.00% in the first-round runner-up contract, up 0.50pp. Real Time gives him 29% in the scenario with Marçal and 30% in the one without, and in a runoff he ties the leader at 44% to 44%. Rejection of 50%, tied with the leader’s.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 55.50% (vol USD 9.56M), unchanged for the fourth day. Real Time gives him 38% in both first-round scenarios and 44% in a runoff against the runner-up, a tie. Rejection of 50%. ⚠️ IN THE SCENARIO AGAINST RONALDO CAIADO HE COMES OUT BEHIND, 45% TO 43%. Across the 41 runoff simulations in the panel’s base he has trailed in four, and all four were against the same opponent. It is the first time in the base that a name other than him shows in front.
sentimento.terceiraVia: Augusto Cury has 10% in the scenario with Marçal and 11% in the one without, and this is the second pollster in a row to put him in double digits, after BTG/Nexus on Aug 31. His price rose to 2.35% (vol USD 3.50M), up 0.50pp against the last published price, from Aug 30. And he has taken the lead in the first-round third-place contract, with 46.65% against 30.00% for Renan Santos. His rejection is 24%, the lowest among the seven names tested in the poll. Renan Santos is at 2.55% (vol USD 12.30M) in the winner contract, up 0.70pp, on the day the ruling that had suspended his campaign was reversed.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the confirmed reading of Sep 1, 8:34 PM BRT (11:34 PM UTC). AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, taken eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20 point. The presidential book has accumulated USD 141.39M.

inss.text1: The pension agency case met the Banco Master case on September 1, and the meeting point is the Supreme Court. The joint congressional committee on the pension agency requested an investigation into the contract between the wife of Justice Alexandre de Moraes and Banco Master, according to Times Brasil.
inss.text2: Until now the two investigations ran in parallel on the panel, one through the pension route and the other through the banking route. The committee’s request joins them into a single object, which is the relationship between the justice’s wife’s law firm and the bank.
inss.text3: The committee’s former chair filed a new impeachment request against the justice, according to Bahia Econômica, and a senator said the Senate will see a flood of requests, according to Poder360. The Senate president signalled to allies that he will schedule none of them and prefers to wait for the Supreme Court, according to Folha de S.Paulo.
inss.text4: The case remains open and unresolved. The distinction the panel has kept from the start still holds: one thing is the effect on the government’s approval, another is the effect on voting intention, and the two do not add up.
inss.impactoLula: This Tuesday’s reading reaches the whole period. Real Time has field from Aug 27 to 31, already after the campaign broadcast slot began on Aug 28, and it is the first in the panel to reach Aug 31. In voting intention the leader stands at 38% in both first-round scenarios.
inss.impactoGestao: No new approval reading this Tuesday. The two most recent remain those of Aug 31, declared in the approval block and not mixed with the panel’s structured block: AtlasIntel/Bloomberg with disapproval of 52.9% and BTG/Nexus with 46% approval against 51% disapproval.
inss.conclusao: On Sep 1 the case stopped being only a pension matter. The joint committee requested an investigation into a contract between a Supreme Court justice’s wife’s law firm and the bank that was already the object of the panel’s other investigation, and from there the subject began to circulate as an institutional crisis. The panel does not attribute the price move to that, which was 0.10pp on the runner-up and zero on the leader.

bancoMaster.text1: IT IS THE STORY OF THE DAY, AND WHAT CHANGED ON SEPTEMBER 1 WAS THE SECRECY, NOT THE INVESTIGATION. The Federal Police report on the relationship between Daniel Vorcaro and Justice Alexandre de Moraes was delivered on August 27 and became public on September 1, when Justice André Mendonça lifted the case’s secrecy, according to Poder360. The document indicates that Moraes edited a contract worth BRL 131 million between his wife’s law firm and the businessman.
bancoMaster.text2: The investigation also points to a second contract, worth BRL 50 million, in which a jet and a helicopter were negotiated. The messages are from November 16, 2025, and Daniel Vorcaro has been in custody since November 17, 2025, with Banco Master’s liquidation ordered on November 18, according to Poder360. That is, the material is from last year and what belongs to September 1 is its disclosure.
bancoMaster.text3: The reaction was immediate and came from both sides. The prosecutor general asked for the Federal Police report to be annulled, according to O Globo, the bar association called for a rigorous investigation, and Mendonça himself asked the court president for a full-bench session to discuss the messages. Four presidential candidates publicly demanded the justice’s departure. The content was first revealed on the night of August 31, in a Metrópoles column.
bancoMaster.conclusao: The case left the banking sphere and entered the institutional one. Until August 30 it circulated as an investigation into a bank and into a lobbyist’s conduct; between the night of August 31 and September 1 it began to circulate as a dispute over whether a Supreme Court justice stays. ⚠️ AND THE PANEL INSISTS ON THE DISTINCTION OF DATES: the messages are from November 2025, the report is from August 27, and what happened on September 1 was the lifting of secrecy and the political reaction. It is the first time the case appears tied directly to a name on the court.

stf.toffoli: HE BACKED DOWN. He released Renan Santos’s campaign advertising on social media, according to Folha de S.Paulo, reversing the previous day’s ruling that had suspended the ticket’s advertising, its funding transfers and its right to take part in debates. The earlier ruling had drawn criticism inside the electoral court, and justices argued for taking the matter to the full bench, according to G1.
stf.moraes: HE IS THE NAME OF THE DAY, AND NOT FOR AN ACT OF HIS OWN. The Federal Police report delivered on August 27, whose secrecy was lifted on September 1, indicates that he edited a contract worth BRL 131 million between his wife’s law firm and Daniel Vorcaro, in custody since November 17, 2025, according to Poder360 and Metrópoles. He ordered the Army to destroy seven of Jair Bolsonaro’s firearms, according to Folha de S.Paulo, and scheduled the ruling on an appeal by Eduardo Bolsonaro, according to G1.
stf.gilmar: No new individual act captured on Sep 1.
stf.dino: No new individual act captured on Sep 1.
stf.mendonca: He suspended the leader’s advertising that used the Rap do Silva for not presenting the running mate, according to Estadão, CartaCapital and Metrópoles. And he asked the court president for a session to discuss the validity of the messages examined by the Federal Police, according to Folha de S.Paulo.
stf.nexo: THE COURT STOPPED BEING THE FRAME AND BECAME THE STORY. In a single day the secrecy was lifted on a Federal Police report about one justice’s conduct, another backed down from a ruling that was blocking a presidential candidate’s campaign, a third suspended the leader’s advertising and asked for a full-bench session, and the prosecutor general asked for the report to be annulled. Four presidential candidates demanded the cited justice’s departure, and the Senate president signalled he will not schedule impeachment.
stf.analise: The contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving through impeachment before 2027 stands at 10.85% (vol USD 86 thousand) in the confirmed reading of Sep 1, 8:34 PM BRT (11:34 PM UTC), up 7.25pp against the 3.60% of Aug 31. It is the panel’s largest move this round, and it came on the day the report’s secrecy was lifted. ⚠️ AND THE SIZE OF THE BOOK HAS TO BE STATED: it is the smallest on the panel, and accumulated volume went from USD 84 thousand to USD 86 thousand, that is, some USD 2 thousand of new business accompanies that swing. Within the day the price passed through 3.50%, 13.80%, 10.70%, 19.10% and 14.30% before settling at 10.85% in the reading. The contract measures a justice leaving, it does not measure whether the investigation prospers nor whether the Senate schedules the request.
